# Research planning

## Directives

From [Digital product development](digital-product-development.md):

- Name the user and the task of each feature before you design or build the feature. ^name-user-and-task

## Definition

The choice of what a study learns and how it learns it, before the study starts. Nielsen Norman Group starts each study with its goals: meet the stakeholders, identify the questions, the concerns, and the purpose of the research, and let the goals determine the method.
